explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/276: is there a Fibonacci-recurrence sequence of composite numbers such that no integer n > 1 shares a factor with every term? 'No integer has a common factor with every term' is correctly encoded as: every n > 1 is coprime to some term. This rules out sequences explained by a finite covering set of primes, as in Graham's construction, whose product would share a factor with every term. Correctly marked open and stated affirmatively.
